policy.promotionRule: Promote only when a generic change signal can be independently verified and mapped through an auditable economic chain to an A-share issuer before the cutoff.
policy.note: This screening is intentionally performed before any post-cutoff A-share price series are fetched.

hypotheses.summary: The January DeepSeek efficiency shock did not eliminate AI infrastructure demand. Pre-cutoff hyperscaler capex and NVIDIA demand signals indicate continued scaling of AI data-center compute and networking, creating a persistent high-speed optical-interconnect demand path.
hypotheses.whyNotHighPriority: The optical-module growth narrative was already well covered by sell-side research before the cutoff. The remaining thesis is a persistence/magnitude and valuation gap, not an undiscovered industry fact.

hypotheses.summary: Rising renewable penetration and negative-price episodes in Europe increase the economic value of grid flexibility and battery storage. A global storage-system supplier with verified European exposure may grow faster than the modest whole-company earnings baseline embedded in pre-cutoff research.
hypotheses.whyNotHighPriority: Storage demand was already a recognized growth theme. The open question is whether the magnitude and mix shift were under-reflected in whole-company earnings expectations.
